female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.body: Pitches that highlight social or educational benefits for children tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-family-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their general family structure fund faster.
female-family-status-faster.body: Pitches from women that include general information about their family structure tend to accelerate funding speed.

female-demographic-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who include specific demographic details fund more slowly.
female-demographic-detail-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify exact demographic figures, such as the number of children, relationship status, or husband's occupation, tend to decelerate funding speed.

female-loan-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of previous loan repayments fund faster.
female-loan-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference a successful track record of repaying previous loans tend to accelerate funding speed.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who include direct thank you notes to lenders may fund more slowly.

female-pitch-length-faster.body: Female borrowers who write significantly shorter pitches may fund faster.

female-higher-loan-amount-faster.body: Female borrowers who request higher loan amounts may fund faster than those requesting smaller amounts.

female-hard-work-language-slower.body: Female borrowers who use phrases emphasizing hard work, such as 'working tirelessly', may fund more slowly.

male-family-mention-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention supporting or living with family members may fund more slowly.

female-loan-amount-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state the loan amount within the pitch text may fund more slowly.

female-homeownership-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention owning their own home may fund faster.

female-generic-family-future-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention securing or providing for the family's future may fund more slowly.

female-widow-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as widows may fund faster.

female-volunteering-repayment-slower.body: Female borrowers who describe social interest repayment through volunteering may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-location-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a specific geographical location may fund faster.
female-geographic-location-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by new observation that geographic descriptions correlate with slower funding.

male-risk-mention-faster.title: Male borrowers who explicitly mention operational risks, such as power cuts or fires, may fund faster than those describing routine activities.
male-risk-mention-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

male-product-listing-slower.title: Male borrowers who list specific products being sold may fund more slowly.
male-product-listing-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that detailed product descriptions accelerate funding for men.

female-geographic-description-slower.title: Female borrowers who include descriptive information about their geographic location or region may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-tourism-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe local geography and tourism of their city may fund faster.
